profile.Name: Protector Of The Flame
profile.Job: Bodyguard of the Holy Lord Phoenix
profile.Personality: A fanatical guard who lets no one near the Phoenix without summons, and treats women and non-humans with open disgust.
profile.Backstory: He guards the Holy Lord Phoenix in Blister Hill and sends would-be petitioners to earn their audience by serving the Inquisition.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Formal and pious: 'The Lord incarnate', 'blessed be his name'; shouts at women and 'beasts' to keep away.
